properties.displayName: Yuma AIA-D04 High-risk Graph permission granted to AI agent or AI app
properties.description: A high-risk Microsoft Graph application or delegated permission was granted to a service principal that is an Entra agent identity, has an AI vendor name, or granted itself the permission. Maps to ISM-2156, ISM-2137, ISM-2138, ISM-2139.
properties.query:
let lookback = 1h;
let AllowedAppIds = _GetWatchlist("YumaAIRegisterApproved") | project SearchKey;   // approved in the AI register
let HighRiskPermissions = dynamic([
    "Application.ReadWrite.All", "AppRoleAssignment.ReadWrite.All", "Directory.ReadWrite.All",
    "AgentIdentity.ReadWrite.All", "DelegatedPermissionGrant.ReadWrite.All",
    "RoleManagement.ReadWrite.Directory", "User.ReadWrite.All", "Group.ReadWrite.All",
    "Policy.ReadWrite.ConditionalAccess", "Mail.Read", "Mail.ReadWrite", "Mail.Send",
    "MailboxSettings.ReadWrite", "full_access_as_app", "EWS.AccessAsUser.All",
    "Files.Read.All", "Files.ReadWrite.All", "Sites.Read.All", "Sites.ReadWrite.All",
    "Sites.FullControl.All", "Chat.Read.All", "Chat.ReadWrite.All", "ChannelMessage.Read.All"]);
let AIKeywords = dynamic(["openai", "chatgpt", "anthropic", "claude", "copilot", "gemini", "perplexity",
    "deepseek", "mistral", "grok", "otter", "fireflies", "n8n", "zapier", "langchain", "cursor"]);
AuditLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(lookback)
| where LoggedByService =~ "Core Directory" and Category =~ "ApplicationManagement"
| where OperationName in~ ("Add app role assignment to service principal", "Consent to application",
                           "Add delegated permission grant")
| where Result =~ "success"
| mv-apply TargetResource = TargetResources on (
      where tostring(TargetResource.type) =~ "ServicePrincipal"
      | extend TargetSpId = tostring(TargetResource.id),
               TargetSpName = tostring(TargetResource.displayName),
               TargetAgentType = tostring(TargetResource.agentType),
               Props = TargetResource.modifiedProperties
      | take 1)
| mv-apply Prop = Props on (
      summarize Bag = make_bag(bag_pack(tostring(Prop.displayName), trim(@'[\"\s]+', tostring(Prop.newValue))), 100))
| extend GrantedPermissions = strcat(tostring(Bag["AppRole.Value"]), " ", tostring(Bag["ConsentAction.Permissions"]),
                                     " ", tostring(Bag["DelegatedPermissionGrant.Scope"]))
// For app role assignments the client app sits in modifiedProperties; for consent it is the target SP.
| extend ClientAppName = iff(isnotempty(tostring(Bag["ServicePrincipal.DisplayName"])), tostring(Bag["ServicePrincipal.DisplayName"]), TargetSpName),
         ClientSpId = iff(isnotempty(tostring(Bag["ServicePrincipal.ObjectID"])), tostring(Bag["ServicePrincipal.ObjectID"]), TargetSpId),
         IsAdminConsent = tostring(Bag["ConsentContext.IsAdminConsent"])
| extend MatchedPermissions = set_intersect(extract_all(@"([A-Za-z_]+(?:\.[A-Za-z]+)+|full_access_as_app)", GrantedPermissions), HighRiskPermissions)
| where array_length(MatchedPermissions) > 0
| where ClientSpId !in (AllowedAppIds)
| extend InitiatorAgentType = tostring(InitiatedBy.app.agentType)
| extend IsAgentic = (isnotempty(TargetAgentType) and TargetAgentType !~ "notAgentic")
                     or (isnotempty(InitiatorAgentType) and InitiatorAgentType !~ "notAgentic"),
         IsAINamed = ClientAppName has_any (AIKeywords) or ClientAppName matches regex @"(?i)\b(ai|gpt|llm|mcp|agent|bot)\b",
         IsSelfGrantByApp = isnotempty(tostring(InitiatedBy.app.servicePrincipalId))
| where IsAgentic or IsAINamed or IsSelfGrantByApp
| extend InitiatedByUpn = tostring(InitiatedBy.user.userPrincipalName),
         InitiatedByApp = tostring(InitiatedBy.app.displayName),
         InitiatedByIp = iff(isnotempty(tostring(InitiatedBy.user.ipAddress)), tostring(InitiatedBy.user.ipAddress), tostring(InitiatedBy.app.ipAddress))
| extend Severity = case(MatchedPermissions has_any ("RoleManagement.ReadWrite.Directory", "Application.ReadWrite.All", "AppRoleAssignment.ReadWrite.All", "Directory.ReadWrite.All", "AgentIdentity.ReadWrite.All"), "High",
                         IsAgentic, "High",
                         "Medium")
| project TimeGenerated, OperationName, ClientAppName, ClientSpId, TargetAgentType, IsAgentic, IsAINamed, IsSelfGrantByApp,
          MatchedPermissions, GrantedPermissions, IsAdminConsent, InitiatedByUpn, InitiatedByApp, InitiatedByIp,
          Severity, CorrelationId

alertDetailsOverride.alertDisplayNameFormat: Yuma AIA-D04: {{ClientAppName}} granted high-risk Graph permission
